title: HGO anisotropic hyperelastic model (per-element fiber directions)
objective: Add the Holzapfel-Gasser-Ogden anisotropic model with two fiber families and per-element fiber direction data, suitable for modelling biological soft tissues.
scope: Add `mechdsl.symbolic.models.hgo` with `HGOMaterial(mu, k1, k2, kappa, fiber_dispersion)`.
The model takes two unit fiber directions per element (a1, a2) passed as per-element data — NOT as material constants.
Strain energy combines an isotropic Neo-Hookean part with two fiber-reinforced exponential terms Psi_f = (k1/(2*k2)) (exp(k2 * <E_f>^2) - 1) where E_f = dispersion-weighted fiber stretch.
Expose as `material_type='hgo'` with a `fiber_data` kwarg on `build_context`.
implementation_steps: Define the material dataclass and the fiber-data schema (per-element (a1, a2) pair).
Implement the strain energy, PK2 stress, and material tangent.
Handle the compressive fiber case: fibers only contribute when the pseudo-invariant I4 > 1 (otherwise set the fiber term to zero).
Unit-test uniaxial along a1: fiber stiffening vs isotropic Neo-Hookean.
Unit-test shear perpendicular to a1 vs shear parallel: shear parallel must be stiffer.
acceptance_criteria: Uniaxial along a1 gives higher stress than isotropic Neo-Hookean at the same stretch.
Shear parallel to a1 vs perpendicular shows the expected anisotropy.
Compressive I4 < 1 sets the fiber term to zero (no buckling artefact).

cases: Fiber direction propagates correctly through ElementIR

risks: Per-element fiber data is a new data shape the pipeline hasn't seen. Mitigation: scope it to ElementIR only; use a numpy array indexed by element id and wire it in as a new optional kwarg.
completion_notes: HGOMaterial(mu, k1, k2, kappa, fiber_dispersion) with positivity/range validators.

pk2_stress / material_tangent_4th / material_tangent_voigt take fiber_dirs: tuple[NDArray, NDArray] as a separate argument; HGOModel wrapper closes over them at construction (one wrapper per element).
Strain energy: Neo-Hookean isotropic + two gated exponential fiber terms with dispersion-weighted E_fi = kd*(I1_bar-3) + (1-3*kd)*(I4_bar_i-1); MacCauley gate E_fi<=0 -> S_fi=0.
FD tangent via 6-probe central-difference of analytic PK2 — sidesteps piecewise derivative at gating boundary.
Frontend: 'hgo' added to _SUPPORTED_MATERIALS; guard requires fiber_data kwarg; ctx['fiber_data'] round-trips.
Gate A: 4/4 scope items, AC1/AC2/AC3 mapped, 0 violations.
Gate B: 0 violations, 2 warnings (lowercase ijkl in test einsum + missing dtype on test fiber array — both test-code informational).
Gate C: 9/9 HGO tests pass; full fast regression 1206 passed / 9 skipped (P4-5 stubs) / 0 unrelated failures.
